description: Aggregated most-visited lens. Reads /api/analytics/popular (or any { pages: [{ url, title?, views }] } endpoint), enriches titles/provenance from pages.json, and reflects loading/ready/empty/unavailable state.

attributes.name: analytics-src
attributes.description: Popularity endpoint URL. Re-fetches when changed.

attributes.name: data-meta-src
attributes.description: Optional pages.json URL; fills missing titles and adds the provenance chip. Fetched in parallel with the endpoint.

attributes.name: data-lens-src
attributes.description: Shared lens pages.json URL (forwarded by content-lens); metadata fallback when data-meta-src is unset. Never used as the endpoint.

attributes.name: limit
attributes.description: Max entries shown (clamped to at least 1).

attributes.name: window
attributes.description: Time window forwarded as ?window=. The VB endpoint accepts 24h, 7d (default) and 30d.

attributes.name: data-heading-level
attributes.description: Heading level 1-6 for the panel heading; 0 renders no heading (e.g. inside content-lens, which already labels the lens).

attributes.name: data-label-view
attributes.description: Count noun used when Intl.PluralRules selects "one".

attributes.name: data-label-views
attributes.description: Count noun for every other plural category.

attributes.name: data-label-unavailable
attributes.default: Popularity data is unavailable right now.
attributes.description: Message when the endpoint fails (internal error detail is never shown).

attributes.name: data-label-empty
attributes.default: Not enough data yet to surface most-visited pages.
attributes.description: Message when the endpoint returns no usable pages.

attributes.name: data-state
attributes.description: Reflected load state; aria-busy="true" accompanies loading. Hide the panel with popularity-index[data-state="unavailable"] { display: none }.

attributes.name: data-error
attributes.description: Internal error detail for debugging when data-state="unavailable" (never rendered).

events.name: popularity-index:state
events.description: Fires when a load settles (ready, empty or unavailable).
